# Getform

Getform is a modern form backend platform that enables developers to handle web forms and submissions without setting up a server or writing backend code.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/getform/.

## Actions

- **Get Form Submission** (read-only): Retrieve a specific submission by its ID.
- **Get Form Submissions** (read-only): Retrieve submissions for a specific form.
- **Submit Form**: Submit form data and files to a Getform endpoint.
